owner: independent energy contributor; Amalgam PR #1278 exclusively owns cumulative Yggdrasil native integration
previous_falsification: ENERGY-CALIBRATE-18: local calibrated 75.83% familiar change sensitivity vs fully marginalized Bayes 91.67% with 5% vs 3.33% NULL false-alarm on distinct held worlds; primary consumed; its raw calibration scores missing.
question: Can retaining up to eight plausible OLD causal hypotheses (rather than just the MAP) recover changed-mechanism sensitivity under fixed interventions, without losing the NULL false-alarm bound and counted computation advantage over complete OLD-hypothesis marginalization?

data.states: five binary inputs and one binary outcome
data.transition_kernel: P(NEW = h | OLD = g, change) proportional to exp[-Hamming(mask(g),mask(h))-I(bias differs)] over all h != g.
data.nonlinear: NEW XOR law from old plus two-input AND gate outside the fitted 62 XOR hypotheses.
data.forbidden_seed_overlap: No primary seed shared with ENERGY-SELECT-14, HYPOTHESIS-15, COVERAGE-16, TRANSFER-17 or CALIBRATE-18; calibration and smoke also disjoint.
data.common_data: All detectors see exact identical OLD events and fixed NEW input/outcome trace per world. Source truth withheld.

controls.candidate: Top posterior OLD hypotheses in descending OLD probability, smallest prefix of <=8 with cumulative OLD posterior mass >=0.95 if possible; normalize retained OLD weights; each OLD anchor has local alternate NEW XOR hypotheses mask Hamming distance <=2, with bias flip allowed; P(change)=0.25, P(no-change)=0.75, internal change alternative transition kernel normalized per OLD anchor; multiply OLD-mixture evidence and NEW likelihoods.
controls.local_MAP: Identical local marginalization but OLD top-k=1, mask radius<=2.
controls.local_top4: Same local model with top-k <=4, posterior mass cutoff 0.95.
controls.local_top8_full_radius: OLD top-k<=8 mass cutoff 0.95, all 61 NEW alternatives per anchor; ablation isolates NEW local mask search.
controls.exact_full: All 62 OLD posterior hypotheses, all 61 alternative NEW hypotheses per OLD anchor, exact same transition prior and likelihood family.
controls.global_MAP: Only most probable OLD hypothesis, all 61 alternatives, exact change prior.
controls.never_change: Declares no change; trivial safety comparator.

calibration.policy: For each probabilistic detector use only 160 independent NULL calibration-world posterior scores, set sorted order-statistic one-based rank ceil(0.97*(160+1)) = 157, declare changed iff posterior > that model-specific rank-157 value. Each model calibrated separately; no held outcomes used.
calibration.original_scores: Commit all 160 per-model raw NULL calibration posterior values (and explicit chosen threshold/rank) so a separate auditor can reconstruct thresholds exactly without rerunning simulator.

acceptance.null_false_alarm: Candidate <=5% NULL false-change rate across 80 held NULL worlds.
acceptance.shifted_detection: Candidate >=0.75 sensitivity on 160 held SINGLE+DOUBLE worlds AND candidate no more than 0.10 below exact_full calibrated sensitivity.
acceptance.improvement_over_map: Candidate sensitivity >= local_MAP sensitivity +0.05 while candidate NULL false-change rate <= local_MAP NULL false-change rate +0.025.
acceptance.proper_brier: Candidate continuous event-posterior Brier on 240 held familiar NULL+SINGLE+DOUBLE worlds <= exact_full +0.020 and no worse than local_MAP +0.005.
acceptance.compute_proxy: exact_full mean counted likelihood and transition operations / candidate >=1.5, all arms include OLD 24-observation fit and 32-input OLD readout.
acceptance.trace_and_retention: Every arm exactly same 24 OLD and 16 NEW observations, first 12 NEW inputs distinct; old posterior & 32 input predictions unchanged through JSON serialize/parse (same process, NOT native cold restart).
acceptance.nonlinear: Report nonlinear out-of-family detection and failure conservatively, not a post-hoc threshold rescue; must be at least local_MAP nonlinear sensitivity minus .05 for DEV_SIGNAL.
acceptance.decision: All criteria must pass for DEV_SIGNAL_UNQUALIFIED; any miss = SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO. No scientific PASS, runtime gain, native learned memory or deployment claims without new independent owner qualifier and full final regression.

process: Protocol commit first. Commit frozen executable second, verify exact source Git blob readback before separate smoke, then one 160-NULL calibration and one 80-seed by four-family 320-world primary (no rerun/postresult tuning). Source-free synthetic; save calibration values and all per-world primary posterior/prediction metrics, action traces and provenance. Independent separate arithmetic audit only; preserve negative. No new background tasks/runners/controllers/paid APIs.
isolation: Existing draft PR #1346, additive new research files only. Do not touch main, accepted learner, Amalgam owner, model checkpoints, original-source first-use, external evidence, workflows, runners, merge or deployment.
